//: The upstream FreeCAD this repository customizes. Fetched at build time, never vendored.
`commit` is the ONLY place a baseline appears -- scripts and CI read it from here so a
bump is a one-line, reviewable change.
How this commit was chosen: the previous shape of this repository was a single squashed
import with no upstream remote and no merge base, so the baseline had been lost. It was
recovered by measurement rather than guessed. Every one of 120 randomly sampled files
that differed from upstream main had its snapshot content present verbatim somewhere in
upstream's history, which established that the divergence was upstream moving on rather
than this fork editing 1,430 files. Diffing the snapshot against all 1,143 first-parent
commits on main then put the minimum at d1424838c2 -- 59 files -- and every one of those
59 is accounted for in patches/, overlay/ or scripts/upstream-ci-files.txt.
FreeCAD adopted CalVer (YY.N) in FEP-0003, so version.json reading 26.3.0-dev is
upstream's own numbering for the third 2026 release cycle, not a fork renumbering. The
